The '''Snake Skull''' is an item that can be obtained by [[fishing]] or digging [[Artifact Spot]]s in [[Ginger Island#Island West|Ginger Island West]], or by digging Artifact Spots at the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Ginger Island Dig Site]].

==Donation==
The Snake Skull can be donated as part of a [[Island Field Office#Snake|Snake]] to the [[Island Field Office]], which rewards 3 [[Golden Walnut]]s and a [[Mango Sapling]] once the specimen is completed.

==Bone Mill==
The Snake Skull can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]].

==Tailoring==
Snake Skull is used in the spool of a [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Skeleton Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt014.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe.
